pages.text: Burns fuel twice as fast for **160 FE per tick**, twice the energy per coal, and stores 100,000 FE.

It needs **water**: 5 mB per tick from an 8,000 mB tank. Right-click it with a water bucket, or pipe water in from another mod. Without water it stops and saves its fuel.

Otherwise it works like the [[heat_turbine]]. The screen shows fuel, stored energy (red) and water (blue).
